Iris properties in Alice Springs -  Gap View Hotel, Todds Tavern, Stay at Alice Springs Resort, Diplomat Motel, Mercure Alice Springs Resort include Lasseters. 

Lasseters is the centre of entertainment in Alice Springs, offering guests an integrated resort with deluxe style accommodation rooms, multiple food and beverage outlets, casino, Health Club / Day Spa and an adjacent Convention Centre. Having recently completed a significant redevelopment programme Lasseters has an enhanced focus on the tourism and hospitality market by providing an exceptional experience to its patrons and guests.


We have multiple opportunities for qualified kitchen staff to join our team of cooks/chefs.  You will be working in all sections of the kitchen; from our traditional a la carte restaurant through to catering large functions driven by the Convention Centre.  Variety is everyday!

Your duties will include preparing, cleaning and running sections during service times and work throughout a 7 day rotating roster covering 76 hours per fortnight as a full time position. 

Cook, including Pastry Cook - Cooking of breakfasts and short order food items; baking, pastry cooking of buns, cakes and biscuits or butchering

Commis Chef - Completed apprenticeship or passed the appropriate trade test for cooking, baking, pastry cooking and butchering

Demi Chef - Completed apprenticeship or passed the appropriate trade test for specialised cooking, baking, pastry cooking or butchery; supervising and training lower grade kitchen staff

Chef de Partie - Completed apprenticeship or passed the appropriate trade test for general and specialised duties including supervision and training of lower grade kitchen staff; ordering and stock control

Sous Chef - Planning menus, estimating food and labour costs, ordering food supplies, monitoring quality, liaising with Managers and other staff, preparing and cooking, select and train staff, explain and enforce hygiene regulations.

These are full time roles with an OTE equivalent salary range between $79,500 to $90,000 gross per annum, excluding superannuation.

Minimum Certificate IV relevant qualification with at least one year full-time experience or equivalent OR three years of experience. 

To be eligible for further consideration you must submit a current CV and cover letter that specifically acknowledges your understanding of the role, the criteria above and the location.

Lasseters has its own enterprise agreement which is modern and reflective of a unique workplace. We offer excellent benefits such as duty meals, fully maintained uniforms provided free of charge, various incentives and a supportive environment.

Where there's life, there's Mercy. 

Where there's care, there's You.

Through the battles and the breakthroughs, we're there. Where will you be?

For over a century, our incredible teams have provided care for people when they need it most. Our Home Care team feels great pride in this, and they value the security and stability we offer. But it also means so much opportunity - to build on all that's gone before, to grow your impact and gain experience that's hard to find elsewhere.

As a for-purpose organisation with over 10,000 dedicated, compassionate people, we continue to offer more services and deeper care than ever before. With Mercy, you'll have the chance to make an impact and gain experience that's hard to find elsewhere.

At Mercy Health, it's all about taking what we have and making it better. 

To do that, we need you. 

Join us as at Mercy Health, and help our teams deliver even greater outcomes.

About the opportunity
At Mercy Health, each moment, no matter how small, truly matters - and as a Home Care Worker, you'll create cherished moments each day. 

You will support our clients to live independently at home by providing personal care, domestic assistance, assisted shopping and meal preparation.

The role offers

Ongoing support provided by a dedicated service team.

Flexible working hours.

Mobile phone. 

What you'll bring

You're reliable, resilient and have a whole lot of heart. Most importantly, you are genuinely interested in supporting others and making a difference in your community. 
 

To thrive in this role, you will have:

Strong communication and organisational skills.

A safe, sensible approach with a practical understanding of people's physical limitations.

The ability to be flexible and adapt to meet clients' individual needs.

You will also be required to provide evidence of, or in the process of obtaining:

Certificate III in Home or Aged Care or Certificate IV in Disability Support. 

National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) Clearance. 

First Aid Certificate that includes CPR. 

Driver Licence. 

Proof of current influenza vaccination. 

Ready to help us shape the future of healthcare?

Join us and make a meaningful difference in people's lives - and your career.

We also have clinical escalation support, plus specialist referral pathways for our main clinical areas — so you can grow your scope over time rather than being boxed into one area.  

 We’re seeking  ambitious, forward-thinking Nurse Practitioners (comfortable to see general health)  who are passionate about addressing gaps in healthcare.

Their vision is to create a comprehensive healthcare hub that provides a wide range of medical services under one roof. result.description:
A fantastic opportunity has arisen for an experienced, Vocationally Registered (VR) General Practitioner to join a thriving, inclusive, and professional medical practice on the beautiful Central Coast. Situated just five minutes off the freeway, the location offers the perfect balance of convenience and lifestyle, making it an easy commute from Sydney while providing an idyllic, family-friendly environment to live and work. The practice operates with a deep commitment to care, fostering a warm and collaborative culture where both patients and practitioners feel genuinely supported. 

 Practitioners will thrive in a state-of-the-art, comprehensive care environment. The facility is a true multidisciplinary hub, offering on-site pathology, general X-ray, physiotherapy, chiropractic services, podiatry, psychology, therapeutic massage, and a pharmacy. This mixed-billing clinic grants doctors full clinical autonomy to practice medicine their own way, while also unlocking excellent opportunities to pursue or develop special interests in areas such as skin cancer medicine. 

 The support structure within the practice is second to none, designed to ensure a seamless and efficient workday. A dedicated, highly skilled nursing team is available during all opening hours to assist with clinical procedures, chronic disease management (CDM), and care plans. Complementing this is a stellar administrative and reception team that efficiently handles patient bookings, billing, and all correspondence in a timely manner, allowing GPs to focus entirely on patient care. 

 Incoming doctors will join a collegiate team of highly professional, supportive peers. The clinic offers strong mentorship and professional development support, with a respected Medical Director available as a trusted sounding board and mentor. For those interested in teaching, there are also excellent opportunities to step into supervisor roles. With highly flexible working arrangements tailored to support a healthy work-life balance, this position is ideal for a GP looking to elevate their career in a truly supportive, turnkey practice environment.
